testPlan.title: TP: xinas-agent — privileged observation & execution daemon (Phase 0)
testPlan.scope: Daemon-level, on-a-running-box behavior of xinas-agent.service (node dist/agent-server.js, User=root, Requires=xinas-api): boot & lifecycle (bind-before-sweep, UDS permissions/fail-closed, signal handling, fatal exit code), convergence/boot sweep (best-effort per-collector, failed-sweep-no-reconcile-delete invariant, one-shot agent_started), RPC dispatch (JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope validation, allow-list routing incl. prototype-pollution rejection, error-code mapping, 1MB DoS guard), the task subsystem (progress taxonomy, stage-failure rollback, requires_manual_recovery, cooperative cancel, idempotent task.begin, config.rollback executor), publisher retry/backoff and 4xx visible-drop, and agent.health derivation. Excludes xiRAID gRPC internals, xinas-api REST/RBAC, xinas-nfs-helper, api-side observed-schema validation, and exhaustive per-collector parsing (already covered by the vitest unit suite).

risks.description: Privilege boundary: agent runs as root and its UDS is the only auth gate; a world-connectable or wrong-group socket lets any local user drive privileged RPC. Must fail closed as root on a chmod/chown error.
Silent observed-data loss: a transient probe failure that reconcile-deletes good api-side observed rows, or a 4xx batch that vanishes with no log.
Task rollback integrity: a failed stage not rolled back, or a rollback failure mis-reported as failed (implying auto-heal) instead of requires_manual_recovery.
Startup wedging: an unavailable xinas-api blocking agent startup so agent.health never answers and systemd flaps. Server must bind before the backgrounded boot sweep.
DoS on the root daemon: an unbounded RPC line growing the per-connection read buffer until OOM. Guarded by the 1MB MAX_LINE_BYTES cap.
Prototype-pollution routing: __proto__/constructor resolving to an inherited handler instead of returning method-not-found.
Idempotency: a re-dispatched task.begin (api reconcile) starting a second run of the same task_id.
Shutdown hang: a held-open client blocking server.close() past systemd's stop timeout; guarded by a 3s forced-exit backstop.

testPlan.environment: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 xiNAS node with xinas-api.service active and xinas-agent.service installed (/opt/xiNAS/xiNAS-MCP/dist/agent-server.js). Config at /etc/xinas-agent/config.json (+ agent-token, controller-id); agent UDS /run/xinas/agent.sock (0660 root:xinas-api); api UDS from config.api_socket. Box tools: systemctl, journalctl, socat or nc -U, getent, jq. For hermetic/failure-injection cases use fixture probe mode (XINAS_AGENT_PROBE_MODE=fixture:<dir>) and the *_POLL_MS overrides. JSON-RPC helper: rpc() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | socat -t5 - UNIX-CONNECT:/run/xinas/agent.sock; }
testPlan.entryCriteria: dist/ built from the commit under test; xinas-api active; agent socket present and reachable by root or a xinas-api group member; a clean api observed-state baseline captured for the reconcile cases.
testPlan.exitCriteria: All P0 cases pass; no high-severity risk (R1-R3) has an open failing case; every negative/error case returns the exact JSON-RPC code specified; no case leaves xinas-agent in failed or activating (auto-restart) at teardown.

testCases.title: agent.health answers while xinas-api is down (bind-before-sweep)
testCases.preconditions: Agent installed; xinas-api stopped (systemctl stop xinas-api).
testCases.inputData: RPC {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"agent.health"}

steps.expected: Agent reaches active (running); journal shows event:"listening" with the socket path.
A JSON-RPC result is returned (not a timeout); status is "starting" (or "degraded" if a probe already errored) with version, uptime_seconds, controller_id, collectors present.

testCases.expectedResult: Health responds independently of api availability; the boot sweep runs in the background and its api-POST failures are logged, not fatal.
testCases.observability: journalctl -u xinas-agent (listening, boot_sequence_failed); RPC reply JSON.

testCases.title: Agent UDS is 0660 root:xinas-api and fails closed on a permission error
testCases.preconditions: Agent active as root.
testCases.inputData: Filesystem inspection + a fault-injected unresolvable socket_group so chown fails.

steps.expected: 660 root xinas-api.

steps.action: As an unprivileged user NOT in xinas-api, connect and send agent.health.
steps.expected: Connection refused / EACCES; no RPC served.

steps.action: Fault-inject an unresolvable socket_group and restart as root.
steps.expected: journal logs event:"socket_perm_failed"; the bind rejects, the process exits non-zero, systemd Restart=on-failure retries; the agent does NOT serve on a mis-permissioned socket.

testCases.expectedResult: The socket is the auth gate; as root a chmod/chown failure is fatal (fail closed). The non-root socket_perm_skipped warn path must not run in production.
testCases.observability: stat; journalctl (socket_perm_failed); systemctl status xinas-agent (Result/restart count).

testCases.title: RPC rejects non-allow-listed and prototype-pollution methods (-32601)
testCases.preconditions: Agent active.
testCases.inputData: methods: "agent.nope", "__proto__", "constructor", "hasOwnProperty", "toString"

steps.expected: Every reply is error.code:-32601 (not in the agent's RPC surface); no handler runs.

testCases.expectedResult: Only own-property allow-listed methods route; inherited Object.prototype keys never resolve to a handler.
testCases.observability: RPC reply error.code via jq.

testCases.title: Oversized RPC line (>1MB) returns -32600 and the connection is destroyed
testCases.preconditions: Agent active.
testCases.inputData: A single ~1.1MB line with no newline.

steps.action: Stream >1MB without a newline into the socket.
steps.expected: Server replies error.code:-32600 "request too large" and destroys the socket; agent stays active (no OOM, no crash).

steps.action: Send a normal agent.health on a fresh connection.
steps.expected: Served normally.

testCases.expectedResult: The per-connection read buffer is capped at MAX_LINE_BYTES; a large-line/slow-loris client cannot grow memory unbounded.
testCases.observability: RPC reply; systemctl status (still active); process RSS unchanged.

testCases.title: Task happy-path emits the full progress taxonomy in order
testCases.preconditions: Agent active; a registered executor (e.g. reference) available; progress captured via api task view or a publish sink in fixture mode.
testCases.inputData: task.begin {task_id:"t-happy", kind:"reference", spec:{...}}

steps.expected: Returns {accepted:true, agent_acceptance_id:<uuid>}.

Order is exactly accepted -> stage_succeeded(snapshot_before, snapshot_id) -> (stage_started -> stage_succeeded)* -> stage_succeeded(snapshot_after) -> terminal(success, snapshot_id); sequence is per-task monotonic from 1; each distinct stage has a unique stage_index.

testCases.expectedResult: Real xinas_history snapshot_before/snapshot_after bracket the stages; terminal is success with the after-snapshot id.
testCases.observability: api task_stages rows / progress-event stream; snapshot_ids resolvable via xinas_history.

testCases.title: Failed initialSweep must NOT reconcile-delete existing observed rows
testCases.preconditions: Api holds a known-good observed snapshot for a kind (e.g. Disk); inject a probe that throws on initialSweep for that kind.
testCases.inputData: Agent restart with the throwing probe for one kind.

steps.expected: journal logs event:"initial_sweep_failed" for that kind.

steps.action: Query api observed rows for the kind.
steps.expected: Existing rows are still present; no complete_snapshots:[kind] reconcile-delete was sent for the failed kind.

steps.action: Let the poll backstop recover the probe.
steps.expected: The kind re-sweeps and reconciles normally once the probe recovers.

testCases.expectedResult: An empty result from a FAILED sweep means unknown, not none; the collector is skipped, its health=error surfaces via agent.health, and no good data is wiped.
testCases.observability: journalctl (initial_sweep_failed); api observed-row count before/after; agent.health.collectors[kind]=error:*.

testCases.title: task.begin is idempotent by task_id (no double run)
testCases.preconditions: Agent active; an executor whose first stage blocks long enough to send a second begin while in-flight.
testCases.inputData: Two task.begin calls with the same task_id:"t-idem".

steps.expected: {accepted:true, agent_acceptance_id:A}; task appears in task.list_inflight.

steps.action: While still in-flight, send begin #2 with the same task_id.
steps.expected: Returns the SAME agent_acceptance_id:A; task.list_inflight still shows exactly one entry; only one run's progress events are emitted.

testCases.expectedResult: Re-dispatch (api reconcile) is safe; a repeated begin never starts a second run.
testCases.observability: The two RPC replies (equal agent_acceptance_id); task.list_inflight count; progress-event stream (single run).

testCases.title: Malformed envelope returns -32600 (parse / missing method)
testCases.preconditions: Agent active.
testCases.inputData: (a) not json; (b) [] (array); (c) {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5}; (d) {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":6,"method":""}

steps.expected: (a) -32600 Parse error; (b) -32600 envelope must be a JSON object; (c)/(d) -32600 missing or non-string method, with id echoed as 5/6.

testCases.expectedResult: Envelope validation precedes routing; id is echoed when a number/string, else null.
testCases.observability: RPC reply error.code + id.

testCases.title: Handler error mapping: EXECUTOR_UNSUPPORTED -> -32000, INVALID_PARAMS -> -32602
testCases.preconditions: Agent active.
testCases.inputData: (a) task.begin with kind:"does.not.exist"; (b) task.begin with no task_id.

steps.expected: error.code:-32000, error.data:{code:"EXECUTOR_UNSUPPORTED", method:"task.begin"}.
error.code:-32602 "task.begin requires task_id + operation_kind".

testCases.expectedResult: Unknown operation kind is a distinct custom code (api maps to 422); bad params are -32602.
testCases.observability: RPC reply error.code / error.data.

testCases.title: Stage failure -> rollback -> terminal(failed, FAILED_PARTIAL_ROLLED_BACK)
testCases.preconditions: An executor whose 2nd stage throws and whose rollback() succeeds.
testCases.inputData: task.begin for that operation kind.

steps.action: Run the task and collect events.
steps.expected: accepted -> snapshot_before -> stage_started(s1) -> stage_succeeded(s1) -> stage_started(s2) -> stage_failed(s2, error_message) -> rollback_started -> rollback_succeeded -> terminal(failed).
status:"failed", error_code:"FAILED_PARTIAL_ROLLED_BACK"; no stage after the failed one ran.

testCases.expectedResult: First failure stops the sequence; the executor's own rollback() runs; drained output_inline is attached to stage_failed/rollback_*.
testCases.observability: Progress-event stream; api task terminal row.

testCases.title: Rollback throws -> terminal(requires_manual_recovery)
testCases.preconditions: An executor whose stage throws AND whose rollback() throws.
testCases.inputData: task.begin for that kind.

steps.action: Run the task and collect events.
steps.expected: ... stage_failed -> rollback_started -> rollback_failed(error_message) -> terminal(requires_manual_recovery).
status:"requires_manual_recovery", error_code:"FAILED_MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED".

testCases.expectedResult: A rollback failure is never reported as a plain failed (which implies auto-heal); it escalates to manual recovery.
testCases.observability: Progress-event stream; api terminal state.

testCases.title: Cooperative cancel honored at a stage boundary -> terminal(cancelled)
testCases.preconditions: An executor with a stage that checks ctx.isCancelRequested() (e.g. fs/xiraid).
testCases.inputData: task.begin then task.cancel for the same task_id before the next stage boundary.

steps.action: Begin a multi-stage task; send task.cancel {task_id}.
steps.expected: {cancel_requested:true}.
Rollback runs; terminal status:"cancelled" with NO error_code.

steps.action: Cancel a fast reference task (no mid-stage check) after it finished.
steps.expected: Cancel is a no-op; task terminates success (a cancel after the last stage is ignored).

testCases.expectedResult: Cancel is cooperative, honored only at safe points (before each stage).
testCases.observability: task.cancel reply; progress-event terminal.

testCases.title: Publisher retry/backoff exhaustion -> pendingReconcile, then recovery re-sweeps
testCases.preconditions: Failure harness where the api returns 503 for N calls then 200; retryBaseMs small.
testCases.inputData: A steady-state observation delta for a kind while the api 5xxs.

steps.action: Emit a delta while api returns 503.
steps.expected: 5 attempts with exponential backoff (250ms->500->..., capped 30s); on exhaustion the kind is added to pendingReconcile.

steps.action: Restore api to 200; trigger the next collector tick.
steps.expected: needsReconcile(kind) is true -> the collector runs initialSweep (full reconcile) instead of an incremental delta; the 2xx clears the kind from pendingReconcile.

testCases.expectedResult: 5xx/network errors retry then reconcile-recover; no observation is permanently lost on a transient api outage.
testCases.observability: journal retry/pendingReconcile; api observed rows converge after recovery.

testCases.title: Publisher 4xx -> no retry, drop is made visible
testCases.preconditions: Harness where the api returns 400 for an observation batch (e.g. a schema-invalid observed row).
testCases.inputData: A delta batch the api rejects with 400.

steps.expected: Exactly one POST (no retries); onPublishError fires -> a structured stderr/journal line event:"observation_batch_rejected" with status:400 and the affected kinds.

testCases.expectedResult: A structurally-wrong payload is dropped without retry but never silently; the reject is logged so a whole kind can't vanish unnoticed.
testCases.observability: journalctl -u xinas-agent | jq 'select(.event=="observation_batch_rejected")'.

testCases.title: One bad collector doesn't abort boot; agent_started still POSTed once
testCases.preconditions: One collector's probe throws; all others healthy; api up.
testCases.inputData: Agent restart.

steps.expected: The throwing kind logs initial_sweep_failed and is skipped; every other kind is swept and reconciled via flushWithSnapshot([kind]).
Exactly one POST /internal/v1/agent_started {controller_id} after the sweep loop, clearing the api heartbeat startup grace.

testCases.expectedResult: Boot is best-effort per collector; a single failure neither aborts convergence nor blocks the agent_started signal.
testCases.observability: journal (initial_sweep_failed); api heartbeat leaving startup-grace; api observed rows for healthy kinds.

testCases.title: config.rollback executor: baseline vs snapshot-id, drift caveat, no-op rollback
testCases.preconditions: xinas_history bridge reachable (or fixture); a known snapshot id present.
testCases.inputData: (a) {reason:"revert", to:"baseline", baseline_id:"baseline"}; (b) {reason:"revert", to:"<snap-id>"}; (c) spec missing reason.

steps.expected: Stage restore calls bridge.resetToBaseline("revert"); output includes 'reset-to-baseline (baseline): revert' then 'baseline reset completed'; terminal success.
Calls bridge.restoreSnapshot("<snap-id>","revert"); output includes the drift caveat ('recovery applied - desired state unchanged; re-apply or adopt to make it durable').
Stage throws 'config.rollback: enriched spec missing reason' -> stage_failed -> terminal.

steps.action: Force the bridge to return success:false.
steps.expected: Stage throws 'runner auto-rollback applies'; the executor's own rollback() is a no-op (the python transactional runner already rolled back - the agent must not fight it).

testCases.expectedResult: to routes baseline-reset vs targeted-restore; targeted restore emits the durability caveat; the executor never runs a compensating rollback of its own.
testCases.observability: Progress-event output_inline; xinas_history state; terminal status/error.

testCases.title: agent.health status derivation (starting / healthy / degraded)
testCases.preconditions: Controllable collector health snapshot (fixture or targeted probe fault).
testCases.inputData: agent.health under three registry states.

steps.action: No collector reported yet (all stubbed / empty).
steps.expected: status:"starting".
status:"healthy".

steps.action: Inject one probe error so a collector reports error:<msg>.
steps.expected: status:"degraded"; collectors map names the erroring kind; uptime_seconds increases monotonically.

testCases.expectedResult: Status is derived purely from the live snapshot; a single error: collector degrades the whole agent (api maps degraded -> EXECUTOR_DEGRADED).
testCases.observability: agent.health reply status/collectors.

testCases.title: Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM (before and after bind) -> exit 0
testCases.preconditions: Agent installed.
testCases.inputData: systemctl stop xinas-agent (SIGTERM); and a race variant delivering SIGTERM immediately after the socket file appears.

steps.expected: journal event:"shutdown", signal:"SIGTERM"; poll driver + publisher debounce stopped first, then collectors (registry.stop, allSettled), then server.close(); exit 0; socket removed.

steps.action: Hold a client connection open and stop.
steps.expected: Shutdown does not hang past ~3s: the forced-exit backstop logs shutdown_forced and exits 0.

steps.action: Deliver SIGTERM right after bind (before post-bind work).
steps.expected: Still runs shutdown() (handlers registered before bind) and exits cleanly.

testCases.expectedResult: Clean teardown ordering; no hang past systemd stop timeout; SIGTERM always reaches shutdown().
testCases.observability: journalctl (shutdown, shutdown_forced); systemctl status Result=; socket absence.

testCases.title: Fixture probe mode spawns no host subprocesses (hermetic)
testCases.preconditions: XINAS_AGENT_PROBE_MODE=fixture:<dir> with sample fixture files.
testCases.inputData: Agent start in fixture mode under strace -f -e trace=execve (or equivalent).

steps.action: Start the agent in fixture mode.
steps.expected: No execve of udevadm/ip/systemctl/getent from the probes; disks/users/nfs-idmap populate from <dir>/*.json; other kinds are empty.

testCases.expectedResult: Fixture mode is fully file-backed - safe for CI or a machine where privileged probes must not run.
testCases.observability: strace execve count; agent.health.collectors.

testCases.title: Restart hygiene: stale socket removed; auto-restart loop bounded
testCases.preconditions: A leftover socket file at the agent path from a prior unclean exit.
testCases.inputData: Start the agent with a pre-existing agent.sock file.

steps.action: Create a dummy file at the socket path, then start the agent.
steps.expected: The stale file is unlinked and re-bound; agent reaches active.

steps.action: Force repeated bind failures (keep the perm fault) and observe restarts.
steps.expected: Restart=on-failure / RestartSec=5s retries without a tight crash-loop.

testCases.expectedResult: A stale socket never blocks startup; failed starts back off per the unit, not a hot loop.
testCases.observability: stat on the socket; systemctl show xinas-agent -p NRestarts.
